title: Toronto Sailing & Canoe Club

services.name: Learn to sail
services.desc: Toronto Sailing & Canoe Club offers the city’s best adult learn-to-sail programs, on both dinghies and keelboats. Every instructor is trained and certified by national authorities in boat safety and first aid, and is ready to provide a safe, fun-filled experience. The TS&CC sailing school curriculum is based on Sail Canada standards. Students can earn nationally recognized certificates by demonstrating skills learned in the program. No previous sailing experience is required to enroll in CANSail 1 (dinghies) or Basic Cruising (keelboats).
